```artifact
/* Finite State Machine (FSM) for Alarm Subsystem */
states:
  Idle
  HighLeakageAlarm
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm
  ACMainLossAlarm

events:
  LeakageMeasured
  ACMainLossDetected
  ACMainRestored
  AlarmTimeout

transitions:
  Idle --> HighLeakageAlarm : LeakageMeasured{averageLeakage > 3 L/min}
  HighLeakageAlarm --> Idle : AlarmTimeout{duration >= X seconds}
  Idle --> InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm : ACMainLossDetected
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm --> Idle : ACMainRestored
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm --> InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm : AlarmTimeout{duration < 2 minutes}
  Idle --> ACMainLossAlarm : ACMainLossDetected
  ACMainLossAlarm --> Idle : ACMainRestored

priorities:
  HighLeakageAlarm: high
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm: continuous-tone
  ACMainLossAlarm: medium

/* Guards and Thresholds */
averageLeakage > 3 L/min
duration >= X seconds (where X is specified in requirement)
duration >= 120 seconds for InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm
```
